name: Marumori (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Marumori town emblem in white: a disc pierced by a stylised arrow and radiating lines.
history: Municipal flag of Marumori, a town in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 8 September 1959.

features.role: Marumori town emblem — a disc pierced by a stylised arrow and radiating lines
